title: IANA PEN, BR risk lists, BR public spending and ANAC RAB vocabulary (P228 iana_pen, P244 br_cnpj_risk_lists, P246 br_public_spending, P248 anac_rab)
notes: Reused: cvm_registrations (p1-G10-3; br_cnpj_risk_lists adds the rows of the listed-company register and the BrasilAPI broker list with registry 'cia_aberta' / 'brasilapi_corretoras'), homonym_risk and name_only_match (p1-G10-2), dataset_age (core review additions), context_only (core).

attributes.iana_pen: IANA Private Enterprise Numbers matched for a company name, domain, PEN number or OID text: [{number, oid (1.3.6.1.4.1.<n>), organization (null for an individual registrant: the name is a person's and is withheld), status assigned|individual|placeholder|unassigned, match exact|possible|domain|domain_suffix|number|oid, email_domains, form (oid text form)}] - organisation-level data only: contact names and full e-mail addresses are never kept
attributes.iana_pen_registry: local IANA PEN registry copy an answer used {dataset, updated (the registry's 'last updated' date), records, fetched_at, stale}
attributes.risk_lists: BR risk-list rows matched for a company (only matched rows enter the case): [{list mte_lista_suja|cvm_sancionador|pgfn_divida_ativa, severity, title, date, amount_band, match exact|root|name_exact|name_possible, as_of}]
attributes.risk_lists_screening: per-list screening state of a CNPJ or company name: {list: {state listed|no_record|not_screened, as_of, line}}; 'not screened against <list> (<date>)' means a missing or stale copy and is never 'clean'
attributes.cvm_authorisation: one-line answer to 'is this broker, adviser or platform authorised by CVM?' from the local CVM registries and the BrasilAPI broker list: 'registered with CVM: active (<registries>)', 'no active CVM registration as of <date>: ...' or 'not found in CVM registries as of <date>' (an absence is never fraud)
attributes.pgfn_debts: PGFN divida ativa summary of a company per debt nature (previdenciaria, FGTS, demais) from the local opt-in index: [{nature, count, total_band, situations, judicial, latest, match exact|root, ref_month}] (amount bands, never the exact debt of an inscription)
attributes.risk_lists_persons: possible name-only matches of an analyst-typed person in the BR risk lists (only with br_cnpj_risk_lists_include_persons set, a recorded purpose and an analyst-typed seed): [{list, name, cpf_masked, match possible, homonym_risk}] - a CPF is never a lookup key and never pivoted
attributes.public_funding: public financing and incentive operations of a CNPJ (at most 20 per provider): [{source bndes|salic, operation_id, organ, value, disbursed, date, product, status, match exact|masked_partial, url, dedup_key}]
attributes.public_funding_coverage: per-provider outcome of a public-spending lookup {provider: {state ok|empty|blocked|rate_limited|quota|error|not_queried, reason}} - a blocked or failed provider reads 'could not verify', never 'no contracts'
attributes.sicaf_supplier: Compras.gov.br SICAF supplier record of a CNPJ {active, qualified, uf, city, cnae, legal_nature, size, supply_lines} (partners, e-mail and phone are never kept)
attributes.aircraft: aircraft of the ANAC RAB matched by registration mark, owner/operator CNPJ or exact company name: [{mark, model, manufacturer, year, owners [company names], operators [company names], registration registered|cancelled|reserved|provisional, since, lien, match mark|cnpj|root|company_exact}] - natural-person owners and operators are dropped at import
attributes.anac_rab_date: date of the ANAC RAB copy an answer used (the 'Atualizado em' line of dados_aeronaves.csv)

tags.esg_labour: listed in the MTE 'lista suja' (Cadastro de Empregadores: employers caught using labour analogous to slavery): labour/ESG red flag
tags.tax_debt: registered in the PGFN divida ativa (federal tax, social-security or FGTS debt): context, debt is common among legitimate companies
tags.cvm_proceeding: named in a CVM sanctioning proceeding (the outcome - acquitted, convicted, settlement, pending - is stated in the title)

relations.iana_pen_contact_domain: company/domain/PEN -> organisation-level contact e-mail DOMAIN of its IANA PEN registration (expand=False; never webmail, never a full address)
relations.aircraft_owner: aircraft mark or company -> CNPJ of a company owning an aircraft in the ANAC RAB (expand=False)
relations.aircraft_operator: aircraft mark or company -> CNPJ of a company operating an aircraft in the ANAC RAB (expand=False)
